'''Peter Bloomfield''' is a British statistician.

Bloomfield completed his doctorate at the [[University of London]] in 1970. His doctoral dissertation, ''Some Problems in the Spectral Analysis of Time Series with Missing Values'', was supervised by [[David Roxbee Cox]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy}}</ref> Bloomfield moved to the United States to teach at [[Princeton University]], where from 1979 to 1983, he chaired the Department of Statistics.<ref name="ncsu2010">{{cite news |title=Bloomfield to Serve as Interim Department Head |url=https://statistics.sciences.ncsu.edu/2010/07/23/bloomfiled-to-serve-as-interim-department-head/ |access-date=29 November 2023 |publisher=North Carolina State University |date=23 July 2010}}</ref> Bloomfield joined the [[North Carolina State University]] faculty later that year.<ref name="ncsu2010"/> Upon retirement, he was granted emeritus status.<ref name="ncsupage">{{cite news |title=Peter Bloomfield |url=https://statistics.sciences.ncsu.edu/people/bloomfld/ |access-date=29 November 2023 |publisher=North Carolina State University}}</ref>

Bloomfield was elected a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 1976,<ref name="imsfellow">{{cite news |title=Honored IMS Fellows |url=https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/ |publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics}}</ref> and to an equivalent honor by the [[American Statistical Association]] in 1993.<ref name="asafellow">{{cite news |title=ASA Fellows |url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/ |access-date=29 November 2023 |publisher=American Statistical Association}}</ref>
